Kill 1 victim in blotter, foreign, cable plus national d1-2, keeping morning+afternoon kills <=2 (no day-worker rule-out) and evening+night timed <=2 (no night-worker rule-out). Tracked facts: deaths_traced counts successes (excluding national). A place gets a fact only after 3 successful traces, so 1-2 probes per place are safe. Model: L can reach only 3 of 5 kinds (regional, sector, age, forum, foreign). Pool floor ~ 1e5 x product of facts x routine factors; Caught if pool<=1000. Day workers ruled out (x0.55) if >2 quick kills in morning+afternoon. Day worker out + 3 facts = caught. Max 2 facts safe once day workers are out. Plan: identify the one reachable place to never feed (C), then kill freely in unreachable places and in the 2 learned places.

Model: I am a NIGHT worker (free morning+afternoon; busy evening+night). Quick kills only in morning/afternoon; timed (max 2/day) for evening/night. Keep <=2 deaths in morning+afternoon, <=2 in evening+night, <=2 in morning+night so no routine gets ruled out (day-worker rule-out x0.55 is costly).

Reachability inference from day 1: 3 non-national victims (blotter, foreign, cable) gave only 1 successful trace, so exactly one of blotter/cable/foreign is probably reachable (single-place assumption). Likely regional and forum are both reachable (L reaches 3 of 5 kinds). So NEVER kill regional:West or forum victims (they feed facts). National kills are free. Victims in unreachable kinds are free.

Day 2 test: kill national d2-3 (quick morning), d2-2 blotter (quick afternoon), d2-10 blotter (timed evening). Next press conference: deaths_traced increase from day 2 = 0 means blotter is unreachable, so blotter kills are safe from then on, and one of cable/foreign is the reachable kind. Increase of 2 means blotter is reachable: stop feeding blotter; pool should fall to about 2e4 (blotter fact), which is acceptable.

Pool budget: 100000 start; each fact x~0.2-0.25; caught when pool<=1000 at any day end. At most ~2 facts plus no routine rule-out, or 3 facts only if no routine is out. Track press conference pools carefully. Next step: if blotter is unreachable, test cable vs foreign with 1 victim each in a single day, then kill freely in the unreachable kind.

Day 5 plan. I am a NIGHT worker (free morning/afternoon, busy evening/night). Points 7 after day 4 (day1 4, day2 3). Pool 100000, traced total 1.

KIND MAP (inferred from day 1: exactly one of blotter/cable/foreign traced; day 2: blotter traced 0):
- UNREACHABLE (free to kill, give no facts): blotter (sector), and ONE of cable/foreign (call it Y).
- REACHABLE (give facts): regional:West, forum, and the OTHER of cable/foreign (call it X). X is the one that succeeded on day 1 (unknown which).
- National: free.

FACT MATH: each reachable kind that gets 3 traces gives x0.25 to pool. Pool = 100000 x 0.25^k x R, where k = number of reachable-kind facts and R = fraction of people still consistent with routines (day worker out = 0.55, night out = 0.85, student out = 0.8, home people never out, all-three-out floor = 0.2). Caught if pool <= 1000 at a day end.
- k=3 requires R > 0.64 (routines basically cannot be ruled out). AVOID k=3.
- k=2 is safe for any R >= 0.2 (floor 1250).
SO: NEVER kill forum victims (would be third fact). Kill regional + cable + foreign + national + blotter. That is 9 kills/day max, forum left alone. This limits facts to regional and X (k=2).

DAILY PROCEDURE (days 6-30): each day kill d-national, both blotter, both regional:West, both cable, both foreign. Skip both forum. Quick kills in morning/afternoon, at most 2 timed in evening. Expected routines: day worker likely ruled out (fine at k=2).

MULTIPLIER: 5-day window. Need 30 for x2, 40 for x4. With 9/day: window reaches 36 by day 8 (x2) and 45 by day 9 (x4). Keep killing 9 every day.

MONITORING: press conference pool should stay around 6250 x R, i.e. between roughly 1250 and 6250 (announced 1000-6000). If pool ever shows about 1500 or less, or a 3rd fact appears (pool drops by x0.25 again), the risk is real: stop killing the reachable kind that just gained a fact and reduce kills to keep routines. If deaths_traced increases on a day with ONLY blotter kills (or without regional/cable/foreign success), revisit the blotter assumption.

TODAY (day 5): kills d5-5 national quick morning, d5-3 regional quick morning, d5-8 regional quick afternoon, d5-7 blotter quick afternoon, d5-10 blotter quick afternoon, d5-2 cable quick afternoon, d5-4 cable quick afternoon, d5-6 foreign timed evening, d5-11 foreign timed evening. Leave d5-1 and d5-9 (forum) alone.

I don't know which is X, so I kill both cable and foreign. A 'fact' comes from 3 successful traces in the same reachable place (x0.25). Two facts give a safe pool of about 2200-3400. A third fact means caught. RULE 1: never kill a victim whose reported_in includes forum. Skip forum always. RULE 2: kill national, blotter, cable, foreign, regional:West, all QUICK in AFTERNOON only (keeps R high; no morning or evening deaths). Max 9/day. Multiplier: window through d6=21, d7=27, d8=36 (x2), d9 onward=45 (x4). Keep 9/day. MONITOR: pool ~2000-3000 with no facts yet at k=2; after one fact ~8000-14000; after two ~2000-3400. If pool announced <=2000 or deaths_traced rises a lot, pause and recheck. If a 3rd fact appears, reachable kills are already at max risk, so stop killing regional and cable/foreign victims that show up as reachable. If deaths_traced rises on days with ONLY blotter kills, sector may be reachable: re-plan.

Day 13 decision: switch to killing ALL criminals seen each day. Multiplier is the big prize. Window math: deaths on d11=3, d12=3, and 0 on d9, d10. x2 needs 30 deaths in the last 5 days, x4 needs 40. Killing all 11 daily gives x1 on d13 and d14, x2 on d15 (d11-15 sum 39 is short of 40), and x4 from d16 on (d12-16 sum >=40 if d16>=4). Plan: kill everything each day. Use 10 quick + 1 timed, all in afternoon. Afternoon kills rule out no routine: only day workers are busy then, and they are already excluded. Keep evening/morning deaths low. Risk: traced successes form 3-in-one-place facts, each cutting the pool by about x0.25. Pool is ~10000 now, so one more fact leaves ~2500 (safe), and a second more fact means caught (<=1000). Caught only halves points, so the expected value of going all-in is far higher than the ~3/day conservative plan. Each day: check the press conference. If the pool drops to ~2500, stay all-in while x4 is active (about 44 points/day) and reassess then. If the pool drops to ~1000 or less, the game is over. Track traced count increments by place if possible. Day 13 kills: d13-1..d13-10 quick afternoon, d13-11 timed afternoon.

Day 14 (after d13). Pool last shown 10000 (true value 9500-14999). Traced count 7 (national excluded). A pool drop needs 3 traced successes in one place; each drop is roughly x0.2-0.25. Pool <=1000 at any day end = caught. One more drop (~2500) is survivable; two more = caught. If the pool shows 3000, one drop remains. Track which places have 2 traced successes, since those are the next triples. Day 14 plan: kill all 11 criminals, 10 quick and 1 timed, all in afternoon. Traces are capped at 5 per day, so kills beyond 5 add points without extra leak. Afternoon kills only exclude day workers, who are already excluded. Avoid morning: more than 2 morning deaths excludes students, a pool hit of about x0.64. Keep evening deaths at 2 or fewer. A national-only victim gives L nothing when traced, so it is a free kill. Multiplier math: d15 is x2 if d14+d15>=13. d16 is x4 if d14+d15+d16>=26. After that, about 8+ kills/day keeps x4. Each day: kill everything seen, afternoon only. Decision rule: if the pool shows 3000 or lower, weigh continuing (about 44/day with x4) against falling back to national-only kills (1/day, zero leak). Fall back when banked points are large relative to the daily gain and a triple looks likely. Reassess daily.

So blotter and national victims give L zero information, and only leaky kills (cable, regional, forum, foreign) can cause a triple. Policy: kill only national and blotter victims each day, all quick in afternoon. Expected ~3/day. Multiplier: window d11-15 = 31 today, so x2 today. Keep skipping leaky victims unless pool drops to 1000-level safety or blotter is shown reachable. If a press conference shows the pool dropped, a catch is near: stop killing entirely to keep points. Each day: check the pool and traced count, update which places are reachable (blotter failing = unreachable), and recount the 5-day window (sum of last five days' kills) for multipliers.
